items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: and then after Eddie Mallory band, I joined Louis Armstrong's band.

ctx.x: Another story, right. That was after I left Chicago and went to New York. But at any rate, I was in Chicago and I was playing with the Milt Senior band at the Gold Coast Club and then after that folded, there was

Eddie Mallory's band, as we spoke of earlier -- the Villa enice, and I worked with Buddand Keg Johnson in that band, and then after Eddie Mallory band, I joined Louis Armstrong's band. Louis Armstrong was based in Chicago in those days, and Budd and Keg and I --
